texts.bulletin: DANGEROUS HEAT STRESS — Alcala: WBGT index in danger zone. SUSPEND all field work from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Ensure field workers rest in shade and drink water every 15 minutes. Apply irrigation to vegetable crops early morning or late afternoon only.
